I'm really glad you reached out and shared this—it takes real courage to be this honest, especially when you're feeling hopeless. Living with bipolar II alongside substance use is genuinely hard, and the fact that you're aware of the harm and struggling to stop doesn't mean you're weak or failing. These things are deeply intertwined, and they're also treatable.

You don't have to untangle this alone. Because bipolar and addiction affect each other, working with a professional who understands both can make a real difference—your doctor or a dual-diagnosis program would be a good starting point. If you ever feel like you might hurt yourself, please reach out right away to a crisis line (in the US, call or text 988) or emergency services.

Hopelessness can lie to you and make change feel impossible, but people do recover from exactly what you're describing. What feels like the hardest part for you right now?
